baseline_models.focus_anchor: The doubled يَوْم frame, يَسْمَعُونَ الصَّيْحَةَ, and يَوْمُ الْخُرُوجِ.
baseline_models.mechanism: A severe event-day is identified by an alarming voice perceived in common; hearing and emergence are linked phases of one public transition from enclosure to exposure.

activation_trace.role: A day can name a severe occurrence; the doubled day-label makes the scene eventive rather than merely calendrical.
Literal auditory perception makes the transition publicly receivable rather than privately inferred.
The alarming cry supplies the abrupt signal that marks the severe occurrence.
Truth as fixed correspondence makes the heard event an actuality rather than a report still open to denial.
Passage to the outside supplies the event's spatial change of state.

changed_reading.before: A cry is heard on a day, followed by an exit.
changed_reading.after: The heard cry identifies the decisive public event itself: fixed reality becomes perceptible as hearers pass out of their prior enclosure.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: يَسْمَعُونَ joined to بِالْحَقِّ and الْخُرُوجِ.
baseline_models.mechanism: Hearing can extend from acoustic registration to understanding and compliance; truth as an unavoidable due turns the cry into an effective summons that brings hidden life outward.

activation_trace.role: Understanding and compliance make hearing a response-bearing reception, not bare sensation.
A fixed obligation makes the summons something due to be answered.
Bringing a thing out of concealment supplies the summons' effective result.

changed_reading.before: People acoustically register a truthful cry.
changed_reading.after: They receive a due summons that cannot remain merely heard; its reception exposes what had been hidden.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earth removes material, while a guarded register retains names and determinations; خروج from concealment can therefore be re-identifiable recovery rather than anonymous replacement.

activation_trace.role: Material diminution supplies the identity problem that emergence must overcome.
The lower ground is the repository from which the later outward passage occurs.
Entry of a name in a register supplies durable individuation despite bodily loss.
Guarding what is retained makes the register a continuity mechanism.
Extraction from concealment anchors recovery back in the focus noun.

structural_cues: 50:4 places what the earth diminishes beside knowledge and a preserving book.
The focus names خروج without itself specifying how identity survives material loss.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies loss, retained registration, and hidden-to-visible خروج; I infer that registration secures re-identifiable emergence, while the live alternative is a record of deeds rather than bodily identity.

changed_reading.after: Those who emerge remain recoverable as the same accountable persons despite the earth's material subtraction.

context_deltas.mechanism: Truth first arrives as a deniable message and rejection leaves the matter mixed; in the focus, the same truth arrives as a public acoustic event, replacing disputable report with experienced actuality.

activation_trace.role: Attributing truth to falsehood supplies the earlier failed mode of reception.
The same fixed truth is the object first rejected and later heard.
Mixture and disturbance describe the unresolved state produced by denial.
Direct auditory perception makes truth an event encountered by its hearers.
Establishing and displaying truth makes the cry resolve the earlier contest.

structural_cues: The earlier object of denial becomes the later content or manner of a universally heard event.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies denial, disorder, and later hearing; I infer that acoustic publicity closes the former space for denial, though the contrast could be rhetorical rather than a causal sequence.

changed_reading.before: The cry conveys a true message.
changed_reading.after: What could be rejected while reported becomes fixed reality when it is publicly heard, ending the mixed state of denial.

context_deltas.mechanism: Water causes plants to issue from earth and revives a dead tract; the explicit comparison 'thus is the خروج' makes the focus emergence organismic, earth-mediated, and life-producing.

activation_trace.role: Plant growth visibly issuing from earth supplies the material analogue for emergence.
Earth's life through rain and growth supplies the transition from inert ground to living output.
Lifeless land supplies the apparently exhausted substrate that can still yield life.
The context's explicit outward emergence names the ecological process as the comparison.
The repeated focus noun receives the earlier growth mechanism.

structural_cues: 50:11 closes the rain-growth sequence with كَذَٰلِكَ الْخُرُوجُ.
The same definite noun الْخُرُوج appears in the focus.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet explicitly supplies the analogy and repeated noun; I carry the growth sequence into the focus as its material model, while it may establish possibility without specifying the exact mode.

changed_reading.before: The dead leave their graves on command.
changed_reading.after: The cry precipitates life-bearing emergence from earth like growth from revived dead land, not merely relocation of inert bodies.

context_deltas.mechanism: Death comes with truth, then wind is sent into the horn and a severe promised day is named; the focus recasts that blast from its production side as the alarming cry received by those who emerge.

activation_trace.role: Loss of life supplies the individual state that the later acoustic event reverses.
Fixed actuality joins death to the same truth phrase later attached to the cry.
Sending wind into an object supplies the blast's production mechanism.
The horn identifies the instrument whose output can be received as the cry.
The severe event-day links the horn scene to the focus's repeated day frame.
The alarming cry is the blast as experienced by its hearers.

structural_cues: 50:20 and 50:42 both use ذَٰلِكَ يَوْمُ to identify the acoustic scene as the decisive day.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies death-with-truth, horn-blast, event-day, and cry-with-truth; I infer that the cry is the received horn output, while the live alternative keeps the two sounds distinct.

changed_reading.after: The cry is plausibly the heard face of the horn-blast that carries individuals from death into the collective event-day.

context_deltas.mechanism: Attentive hearing first belongs to a present witness and is then commanded to one listener; a nearby caller raises the voice, after which the focus shifts to plural indicative hearing. Voluntary attention becomes collective exposure.

activation_trace.role: Understanding and acceptance make cast hearing an intentional mode of reception.
Presence with observation distinguishes attended hearing from stray sound.
The imperative to listen stages deliberate auditory readiness immediately before the focus.
Raised calling supplies the voiced source that becomes a heard cry.
Nearness closes spatial distance between caller and receivers.
Plural hearing completes the scale change from one addressee to the exposed collective.

structural_cues: 50:37 conditions remembrance on one who casts hearing while present.
50:41 uses a singular imperative, while 50:42 uses a plural indicative verb.
The caller is from a near place immediately before the cry is heard.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies attentive hearing, a singular command, a near caller, and plural reception; I infer an escalation from optional readiness to unavoidable common hearing, though the plural may simply identify a different group.

changed_reading.before: The audience is told to listen for a future cry.
changed_reading.after: The focus marks the threshold at which listening ceases to be one person's voluntary posture and becomes the collective's unavoidable exposure to a near summons.

context_deltas.mechanism: The agent who causes death also sets the terminus 'to Us'; therefore خروج is not escape into open space but a transition whose vector ends at a fixed destination.

activation_trace.role: Causing life's force to depart makes death one controlled phase of the transition.
Becoming toward an outcome supplies the destination and direction of emergence.
Outward passage remains the focus motion now given a terminus.

structural_cues: 50:43 follows the focus immediately and makes the destination explicit with إِلَيْنَا.
Life, death, and destination are coordinated under the same first-person agency.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies controlled death and a destination immediately after خروج; I infer a directed route from one to the other, while they may instead be adjacent statements without a mapped trajectory.

changed_reading.before: Emergence is movement out from the earth.
changed_reading.after: Emergence is the outward leg of a controlled passage whose defining endpoint is arrival to the stated destination.

context_deltas.mechanism: Ground splits open around the people, they move without delay, and their outward motion is collected toward one purpose; divine ease makes opening, exit, and assembly a single controlled operation.

activation_trace.role: Fissuring and opening supply the physical aperture for خروج.
The lower ground identifies the enclosing medium that opens around them.
Absence of slowness gives emergence its abrupt kinetic profile.
Driving and collecting a group toward a goal gives outward motion a social destination.
Opening and ease after difficulty characterize the whole operation as unobstructed.
The focus's outward passage is the motion physically and socially specified by the next scene.

structural_cues: 50:44 resumes the focus's يَوْمَ ... ذَٰلِكَ frame.
عَنْهُمْ identifies the people as emerging through the split earth.
The sequence moves from opening to speed to gathering to ease.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies split ground, speed, gathering, and ease; I infer the arrow ground opens to exit to directed assembly, while the details could be coordinated descriptions without strict causal order.

changed_reading.before: The day of خروج is a generic resurrection scene.
changed_reading.after: It is a rapid, unobstructed operation: earth opens around the people and their egress is immediately organized into gathering.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: Surprising because the cited صيح branch is a sounding fracture rather than the ordinary cry; it remains anchored in الصَّيْحَةَ, الْخُرُوجِ, and 50:44's explicit earth fissure. Render only as an exploratory acoustic-material overlay, not as a lexical replacement of 'cry' with 'fissure'.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: الصَّيْحَةَ beside الْخُرُوجِ, followed by تَشَقَّقُ الْأَرْضُ.

activation_trace.role: A fracture that produces sound lets the cry carry a material rupture-image.
Outward passage requires the opening whose sound is being explored.
The earth's explicit fissuring supplies the later material counterpart to the focus sound.

changed_reading.before: A cry sounds and then the earth opens for emergence.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the cry may be the audible face of the same rupture through which emergence occurs: sound and aperture are two aspects of one break.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: Surprising because proprietary right and monetary outflow are peripheral branches of حق and خرج; it remains anchored in بِالْحَقِّ and الْخُرُوجِ and gains support from the register and witness sequence. Render as a juridical-exaction analogy, never as the direct translation of the focus phrase.

activation_trace.role: A specific right held by its claimant supplies the due claim to be settled.
A known payment that goes out supplies the exploratory exaction image.
A written establishment that imposes judgment supplies the fixed account.
Testimony stated with knowledge supplies evidentiary presence at settlement.

changed_reading.before: The day is when people emerge.
changed_reading.after: As a contained legal analogy, it is also the day each accountable person is brought out and every established due is exacted under record and witness.

strongest_changes: 50:11 turns خروج into germination-like emergence from revived dead earth.
50:19-20 and 50:41 make the cry a near public summons plausibly aligned with the horn-blast.
50:44 specifies emergence as earth-opening, rapid motion, and directed gathering.
summary.what_was_special: The trace is activated less by a broad resurrection theme than by repeated constructions and state changes: denied truth becomes heard truth, singular listening becomes plural hearing, preserved identity passes through material loss, and outward motion acquires both an aperture and a destination.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether الصَّيْحَة is identical with the horn-blast or follows it as a distinct sound.
Whether the preserving book in 50:4 secures bodily identity or only records deeds.
Whether the sounding-fissure and due-exaction overlays belong in prose or should remain trace-only.
